scope: Typed frozen runtime UI layout/style authoring, virtual geometry observation and explicit capture density; no editor activation or physical-device qualification.

cases_cover: Transactional complete definitions, previews, exact retry receipts, history and restart
24 malformed late metadata cases reject atomically
Legacy seven-field definitions and frozen content hashes retain absent metadata
Focused mutation discovery equals the full UI schema and exposes bounded layout/capture parameters
Virtual layout available/unavailable and invalid/stale observations leave authored state untouched
Virtual geometry at 960x540, 1280x720 and 1024x768 at scale 1 plus 1280x720 at scale 2
Runtime freezes layout/style and rejects live metadata edits; a fresh runtime adopts changed authoring
Legacy UI checkpoint round-trip retains logical state and content identity
Rechecksummed saved-world metadata mismatch is rejected against the original inner trusted content identity
typed_ui_contract.round_clip_validation: Positive panel border radius with own hidden/auto overflow is rejected; rounded clip masks are not implemented.

native_input_regressions: Visual sibling order and traversal independent of logical ID serialization
Pass-through canvases, capturing panel padding and clipping
Held pointer and confirmation preserve owned releases across target/action/occlusion changes
Fresh and held keyboard confirmation cannot activate a fully occluded control
Unrelated drawn HUD text update can preserve a held compatible gesture
Hover/focus/pressed/disabled color states and hidden flex roots

compiled_callbacks.scope: Existing unchanged compiled UI fixture and control/save contracts rerun on the rebuilt engine; no newly authored complete game.

legacy_pixel_pairing.pixel_digest_format: Top-to-bottom BGR8 rows, excluding alpha and row padding.

image.conversion: Lossless BMP RGB pixels to PNG; visually inspected. This is a native readback, not an OS/editor screenshot.

limits: Three rendered extents cover two aspect ratios, with explicit UI scale 1. Scale 2 has virtual-layout qualification only.
Legacy pixel equality covers seven scenes on the AMD GPU only; it does not prove all old worlds are identical.
Color witnesses measure opaque interior patches with a two-byte rounding tolerance; no general text-shaping or geometric anti-aliasing claim.
Semantic hitability uses bounded point sampling; thin or partly occluded regions may report false despite a small clickable region.
The fixture has no compiled gameplay callback, physics body/controller or physical device. Tick/control sequence checks are not physics-trajectory proof.
Existing compiled callbacks are qualified separately; editor visual authoring and installed desktop package are unchanged.
Theme inheritance, images, inventory/text widgets, animation, accessibility and localization remain unfinished.
UI/layout/capture APIs remain outside the selected stable authoring-core contract; broader game-scale performance and alpha readiness are not established.
